# STAC 1.1.0 schemas

The JSON Schemas of STAC 1.1.0's Catalog and Collection, and the ones they refer to, as published at `https://schemas.stacspec.org/v1.1.0/`, unchanged. Downloaded on 2026-11-15. `../stacSchemas.ts` checks the tests' catalogues against them.

They are part of the STAC specification (`radiantearth/stac-spec`), released under the Apache License 2.0, the licence of this package's `LICENSE`.
